idea-plugin.name: Vuka
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for Vuka in GoLand and the other JetBrains IDEs with LSP support: .vuka files (Go with Result, Option, ?, match, decorators and JSX) and .vuka.html templates.
  • Completion, hover, go to definition, references, rename, diagnostics, code actions, inlay hints and formatting through vuka lsp
  • Highlighting of .vuka files by the VS Code extension's TextMate grammar
  • The project's own go tool vuka when go.mod declares it
Requires vuka (on PATH or as a tool of the module) and gopls.

action.description: Stop vuka lsp and start it again
